name: 046_tv_chartart_macd_sma
hypothesis: TradingView port T3 (PLAN.md section 13) from the Pine source the owner supplied: 'MACD + SMA 200 Strategy (by ChartArt)' v1.0. The author's claim: go with momentum only when the long-term trend agrees - long when the MACD histogram crosses above zero while MACD > 0, the fast MA is above the slow MA and the close of 26 bars ago is above the 200 SMA; short on the mirror image. Counterparty: traders fading an established trend. Author defaults kept: fast 12, slow 26, signal 9, very slow 200, all SIMPLE moving averages as in the script (not the usual EMA MACD). DEVIATIONS: (1) the script has no exit - it only reverses on the opposite entry - and caps intraday equity loss at 50%; the engine has no stop-and-reverse and every trade must risk 1%, so a pct stop (4%/6%) and a time stop (120/480 h at 4h) are added and are the only grid keys; (2) the entry is a stop order at the signal bar's low (long) / high (short), which is on the other side of the market, so it fills at the next open - the engine's taker entry; if the next bar gaps beyond it, TradingView would fill at that level or not at all; (3) the 'cancel' lines only remove unfilled orders and never change a filled trade here; (4) TradingView's default commission is 0, here 0.05% taker + 0.02% slippage + funding. Source chart 4h; variants in chart mode. UPDATE before any run (owner-approved engine feature exit_on): the TradingView script reverses on the opposite signal, and the port now does the same (exit_on 'opposite': the opposite trigger closes the position at the next open, and re-enters the other way if that side is allowed). The pct stop stays as the mandatory 1%-risk stop; the time stop is a long safety cap.
